metadata.issueBody:
## Summary

#6023 made the engine's shared gh runners spawn gh with `plainGhEnv()`, so a color-forcing env (for example `CLICOLOR_FORCE` set to a non-zero value) can't break `JSON.parse` of gh output. Three gh reads on the release paths were not covered. They still pass `{ ...process.env }` to gh and then parse its stdout as JSON:

| Site (master `8381e3ac`) | Call | Parse |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/core/src/release/gh.ts:134` | `gh release view <tag> --json isDraft` | `JSON.parse` at :145 |
| `packages/core/src/release-publish/gh-api.ts:29` | `gh api --paginate <releases endpoint>` | `JSON.parse` at :40 |
| `packages/core/src/release-rollback/gh.ts:34` | `gh release view <tag> --json isDraft,name,…` | `JSON.parse` at :41 |

gh documents that `CLICOLOR_FORCE` (any value but `0`) keeps ANSI color when stdout is piped, and it wins over `NO_COLOR` (see the comment in `packages/core/src/subprocess/plain-gh-env.ts`). With it set, each read above gets colored JSON and the parse fails:

- `release:publish` stops with a non-JSON `gh-error` before it changes anything.
- `release:rollback` reads the release as an error rather than present or not found, and halts.
- The release draft-state read returns an error state instead of the draft state.

`release:publish` and `release:rollback` fail closed, so nothing is published or deleted by mistake. But neither command can be used in such an env, and the error doesn't name the cause.

The `[Unreleased]` CHANGELOG line from #6030 ("so every shared engine gh read forces plain output") overstates the #6023 coverage, since these three reads are not included.

## Fix

Bug fix only, no new features or flags:

- At each of the three sites, pass `env: plainGhEnv()` instead of `env: { ...process.env }`, as #6028-#6030 did for the other runners. `process.env` stays unchanged.
- Optional, same change for consistency: the non-parsed gh spawns in the same files (`release/gh.ts:99` and `:166`, `release-publish/gh-api.ts:111`, `release-rollback/gh.ts:84`).
- Reword the `[Unreleased]` CHANGELOG line so it no longer claims every engine gh read, and add a `Fixed` line for this change.

## Acceptance

- [ ] The three reads above spawn gh with an env built by `plainGhEnv()` (no `CLICOLOR_FORCE`, `FORCE_COLOR` or caller `NO_COLOR`; `NO_COLOR=1`).
- [ ] One test per site, using the existing `pr-protected-issues/fixtures/color-gh-stub.mjs` pattern or a `spawnText` seam, shows the read parses under a parent env with `CLICOLOR_FORCE=1` and fails on base.
- [ ] Existing release, release-publish and release-rollback tests pass unchanged.
- [ ] The CHANGELOG wording is corrected.

Refs #6023

Filed for @MScottAdams
